title: Input, Output, and Operators
objectives: Explain Write/WriteLine/ReadLine; interpolation; TryParse; arithmetic / and \; Mod/^; comparisons; And/Or/Not; short-circuit AndAlso/OrElse; compound assignment; &.

introduction: Develop Write/WriteLine/ReadLine; interpolation; TryParse; arithmetic / and \; Mod/^; comparisons; And/Or/Not; short-circuit AndAlso/OrElse; compound assignment; &. Use fictional records and a supported .NET development environment.
explanation: Console.ReadLine returns a string or Nothing at end of input. Write stays on the same line and WriteLine adds a newline. Use TryParse and a stated culture for numeric input, then validate the domain. / performs division; \ performs integer division; Mod gives a remainder and ^ exponentiation. = is equality in a comparison and assignment in an assignment statement; <> means unequal. And/Or evaluate both sides, while AndAlso/OrElse short-circuit and are useful for safe validation. & explicitly concatenates strings. Check division by zero and use integer inputs for integer-division/remainder exercises rather than silently rounding fractional inputs.
syntax:
Option Explicit On
Option Strict On
Imports System.Globalization
Module Program
    Sub Main()
        Console.InputEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8
        Console.OutputEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8
        Dim first, second As Integer
        If Not Integer.TryParse(Console.ReadLine(), first) OrElse Not Integer.TryParse(Console.ReadLine(), second) Then
            Console.WriteLine("Invalid integer input")
            Return
        End If
        Console.WriteLine($"Add: {first + second}; Subtract: {first - second}; Multiply: {first * second}")
        If second = 0 Then
            Console.WriteLine("Cannot divide by zero")
        Else
            Console.WriteLine("Divide: " & (first / second).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
            Console.WriteLine($"Integer divide: {first \ second}; Remainder: {first Mod second}")
        End If
    End Sub

End Module

title: Conditional Statements and Loops
objectives: Explain If/ElseIf/Else; Select Case; nested conditions; For/While/Do While/Do Until/For Each; Exit/Continue; counters/accumulators.

introduction: Develop If/ElseIf/Else; Select Case; nested conditions; For/While/Do While/Do Until/For Each; Exit/Continue; counters/accumulators. Use fictional records and a supported .NET development environment.
explanation: Conditions choose a path and loops repeat bounded work. Validate grades before classifying them. Check high bands first: 90–100 Excellent, 85 to below 90 Very Good, 80 to below 85 Good, 75 to below 80 Passed, otherwise Failed. Continuous ranges also classify fractional grades correctly. Select Case is useful for discrete choices or explicit ranges. For...Next counts through a range; While and Do variants check a condition, and For Each reads collection values. Exit For/Exit Do end loops, while Continue For skips one iteration. Counters and accumulators track counts and totals. Nested loops multiply work and must have sensible bounds.
syntax:
Option Explicit On
Option Strict On

Module Program
    Sub Main()
        Console.InputEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8
        Console.OutputEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8
        Dim grades As Double() = {95, 87.5, 82, 75, 60, 101}
        Dim validCount As Integer = 0
        For Each grade As Double In grades
            If grade < 0 OrElse grade > 100 Then
                Console.WriteLine("Invalid grade")
                Continue For
            End If
            Dim result As String
            If grade >= 90 Then
                result = "Excellent"
            ElseIf grade >= 85 Then
                result = "Very Good"
            ElseIf grade >= 80 Then
                result = "Good"
            ElseIf grade >= 75 Then
                result = "Passed"
            Else
                result = "Failed"
            End If
            validCount += 1
            Console.WriteLine(result)
        Next
        Console.WriteLine($"Valid grades: {validCount}")
    End Sub

End Module

title: Arrays and Procedures
objectives: Explain array declarations/initializers/indexes/updates/Length; For Each; multidimensional arrays; Sub/Function; parameters/arguments/returns; ByVal/ByRef; scope.

introduction: Develop array declarations/initializers/indexes/updates/Length; For Each; multidimensional arrays; Sub/Function; parameters/arguments/returns; ByVal/ByRef; scope. Use fictional records and a supported .NET development environment.
explanation: Arrays have fixed length and zero-based indices. Dim values(4) As Double allocates five elements, since the bound is the highest index. A two-dimensional array uses two indices and GetLength for each dimension. Sub performs an action without a return value; Function returns a value. Parameters are placeholders and arguments are supplied values. ByVal copies the argument value; for reference types that value is a reference, so the referred array/object can still be modified. ByRef allows reassignment of the caller variable. Prefer ByVal unless the contract needs ByRef, and check empty arrays before averaging.
syntax:
Option Explicit On
Option Strict On

Module Program
    Sub Main()
        Console.InputEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8
        Console.OutputEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8
        Dim grades As Double() = {90, 80, 100}
        Console.WriteLine($"Average: {Average(grades):F2}")
        Console.WriteLine($"Highest: {Highest(grades)}; Lowest: {Lowest(grades)}")
        Console.WriteLine(If(Average(grades) >= 75, "Passed", "Failed"))
    End Sub
    Function Average(ByVal grades As Double()) As Double
        If grades.Length = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Empty grades")
        Dim total As Double = 0
        For Each grade As Double In grades
            total += grade
        Next
        Return total / grades.Length
    End Function
    Function Highest(ByVal grades As Double()) As Double
        If grades.Length = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Empty grades")
        Dim value As Double = grades(0)
        For Each grade As Double In grades
            If grade > value Then value = grade
        Next
        Return value
    End Function
    Function Lowest(ByVal grades As Double()) As Double
        If grades.Length = 0 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Empty grades")
        Dim value As Double = grades(0)
        For Each grade As Double In grades
            If grade < value Then value = grade
        Next
        Return value
    End Function
End Module

        Catch ex As JsonException
            MessageBox.Show("Practice file has invalid records")
        Catch ex As IOException
            MessageBox.Show("Practice file could not be loaded")
        End Try
    End Sub

introduction: Develop provider; connection/command/parameters/reader; DataAdapter/DataTable concepts; CRUD; Using; connection strings; secure configuration. Use fictional records and a supported .NET development environment.
explanation: ADO.NET providers expose connections, commands, parameters, and readers for particular databases. This lesson uses Microsoft.Data.Sqlite and a disposable in-memory educational database, never CodeLab tables. Keep the connection open for the lifetime of an in-memory SQLite database. Using disposes connections, commands, and readers deterministically. Bind values as parameters instead of concatenating SQL; table/column identifiers require a fixed allowlist. ExecuteNonQuery handles modifications, ExecuteReader reads rows, and ExecuteScalar reads a single value. DataTable can load a reader; Microsoft.Data.Sqlite has no DataAdapter implementation, while providers such as SQL Server have one. Package references and connection syntax are provider-specific.
syntax:
Option Explicit On
Option Strict On
Imports Microsoft.Data.Sqlite
Module Program
    Sub Main()
        Console.InputEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8
        Console.OutputEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8
        Using connection As New SqliteConnection("Data Source=:memory:")
            connection.Open()
            Using schema = connection.CreateCommand()
                schema.CommandText="CREATE TABLE Students(Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, Name TEXT NOT NULL, Average REAL NOT NULL CHECK(Average BETWEEN 0 AND 100));"
                schema.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Using insert = connection.CreateCommand()
                insert.CommandText="INSERT INTO Students(Id,Name,Average) VALUES(@id,@name,@average);"
                insert.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id",1)
                insert.Parameters.AddWithValue("@name","O'Brien")
                insert.Parameters.AddWithValue("@average",90)
                insert.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Using update = connection.CreateCommand()
                update.CommandText="UPDATE Students SET Average=@average WHERE Id=@id;"
                update.Parameters.AddWithValue("@average",92) : update.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id",1)
                update.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Using query = connection.CreateCommand()
                query.CommandText="SELECT Id,Name,Average FROM Students WHERE Id=@id;"
                query.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id",1)
                Using reader = query.ExecuteReader()
                    While reader.Read()
                        Console.WriteLine($"{reader.GetInt32(0)}: {reader.GetString(1)} — {reader.GetDouble(2)}")
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Using delete = connection.CreateCommand()
                delete.CommandText="DELETE FROM Students WHERE Id=@id;"
                delete.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id",1) : Console.WriteLine($"Deleted: {delete.ExecuteNonQuery()}")
            End Using
        End Using
    End Sub

End Module

Option Explicit On

Imports System
Imports System.Collections.Generic
Imports System.Security.Cryptography
Imports Microsoft.Data.Sqlite
Public Class StudentRow
    Public Property Id As Long
    Public Property Name As String=""
    Public Property Average As Double
End Class
Public Class StudentRepository
    Private ReadOnly connectionString As String
    Public Sub New(practiceConnectionString As String)
        connectionString=practiceConnectionString
    End Sub
    Public Function ListStudents() As List(Of StudentRow)
        Dim result As New List(Of StudentRow)
        Using connection As New SqliteConnection(connectionString)
            connection.Open()
            Using command=connection.CreateCommand()
                command.CommandText="SELECT Id,Name,Average FROM Students ORDER BY Name,Id;"
                Using reader=command.ExecuteReader()
                    While reader.Read()
                        result.Add(New StudentRow With {.Id=reader.GetInt64(0),.Name=reader.GetString(1),.Average=reader.GetDouble(2)})
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
        End Using
        Return result
    End Function
    Public Sub AddStudent(session As ApplicationSession,name As String,average As Double)
        If Not session.CanManageStudents Then Throw New UnauthorizedAccessException("Management permission required")
        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) OrElse Double.IsNaN(average) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(average) OrElse average<0 OrElse average>100 Then Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid student")
        Using connection As New SqliteConnection(connectionString)
            connection.Open()
            Using command=connection.CreateCommand()
                command.CommandText="INSERT INTO Students(Name,Average) VALUES(@name,@average);"
                command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@name",name.Trim()) : command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@average",average)
                command.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
        End Using
    End Sub
End Class
Public Class ApplicationSession
    Public ReadOnly Property UserId As Long
    Public ReadOnly Property Role As String
    Friend Sub New(userId As Long,role As String)
        Me.UserId=userId : Me.Role=role
    End Sub
    Public ReadOnly Property CanManageStudents As Boolean
        Get
            Return Role="manager" OrElse Role="admin"
        End Get
    End Property
End Class
Public Class AuthenticationService
    Private ReadOnly connectionString As String
    Public Sub New(practiceConnectionString As String)
        connectionString=practiceConnectionString
    End Sub
    Public Function Login(username As String,password As String) As ApplicationSession
        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) OrElse String.IsNullOrEmpty(password) Then Return Nothing
        Using connection As New SqliteConnection(connectionString)
            connection.Open()
            Using command=connection.CreateCommand()
                command.CommandText="SELECT Id,Role,Salt,PasswordHash,Iterations FROM PracticeUsers WHERE Username=@username;"
                command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@username",username.Trim())
                Using reader=command.ExecuteReader()
                    If Not reader.Read() Then Return Nothing
                    Dim salt As Byte()=CType(reader.GetValue(2),Byte())
                    Dim stored As Byte()=CType(reader.GetValue(3),Byte())
                    Dim iterations As Integer=reader.GetInt32(4)
                    If iterations<100000 OrElse iterations>2000000 Then Throw New InvalidOperationException("Invalid hash parameters")
                    Dim candidate As Byte()=Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password,salt,iterations,HashAlgorithmName.SHA256,stored.Length)
                    If Not CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(stored,candidate) Then Return Nothing
                    Return New ApplicationSession(reader.GetInt64(0),reader.GetString(1))
                End Using
            End Using
        End Using
    End Function
End Class
